    """Draw a color-3 path from color 1 toward color 2: diagonal first,
    then straight along the remaining axis, stopping diagonally adjacent to 2."""

    one = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]

        r += sr

        r += sr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc - c) > 1:
